nodes.title: Free soluble group of rank two

nodes.title: Free soluble groups of rank two have test elements

nodes.summary: The statement that for every integer $d > 2$ the free soluble group $F_2 / F_2^{(d)}$ of rank $2$ and derived length $d$ has a test element, where $F_2$ is the free group on two generators and $F_2^{(d)}$ is the $d$-th term of its derived series.
nodes.title: Kourovka Problem 14.88 (test elements of free soluble groups of rank 2)

nodes.summary: An element $u$ of a group $G$ is a test element of $G$ if every endomorphism $\varphi$ of $G$ with $\varphi(u) = u$ is bijective, that is, an automorphism of $G$.
nodes.title: Test element
